title: Page complete Dispatch and place-tree audiences beyond the Data API row ceiling

source.ref: Actual resolver reproduction returned 1000 of 1205 synthetic Circle members; API max_rows=1000, 2026-10-23

detail: Global Dispatch selected profiles without paging; scoped recipient hydration used one unbounded ID query. Shared place-tree selectors also stopped at the Data API ceiling at hubs, circles or memberships. A real-function synthetic reproduction returned only 1000 of 1205 Circle members before repair. A shared SDK-free cursor reader now walks stable id-ordered pages of 500, rejects failed/stalled/oversized reads, and preserves the existing 20000-row bound explicitly rather than clipping. Place-tree reads page each layer and batch ID filters in groups of 100; Dispatch pages global IDs and hydrates details in 100-ID queries before any sends. Existing scope authorization, global active/non-demo filters, send gates, platform after registration and fanout concurrency=12 remain. Actual action/resolver fixtures cover 1205 global/scoped/Circle/Hub/Nexus recipients with a realistic 1000-row response cap, later-read failure sends nothing, and denied scope writes nothing. Fifty-eight existing/expanded focused tests, lint and six assertion-level regression controls pass. One old audience fixture lacked the new query modifiers; it now models stable ordering, limit and cursor while preserving its original cross-Space assertion. No production rows, emails or push deliveries were touched. Whole-tree type/build integration remains to be checked; no production throughput, durable completion or provider acceptance is inferred. Whole-tree integration caught a nullable display-name mismatch at the email template boundary; hydration now supplies the existing neutral greeting when the name is absent. The actual-action probe exercises synthetic allowed-email delivery for both absent and present names; no provider is called. Integration validation is being rerun on the correction. Integrated audience repair878289f3f now passes whole-tree typing, a real Frequency compile and all six enforcing local artifact gates. Frozen036 consequence sweep asks1745probes, with1744agreements and onlyLIVE884indeterminate. This does not establish provider delivery, production artifact shape or the guard cost contract.

verify.note: Execute actual action, shared pager and place-tree resolver with synthetic capped query builders and provider recorders; no database/Auth/provider calls.
